Game Overview

Dog and Cat is a two-player game built around join a lovable dog and cat duo on an enchanting quest. Collect scattered boxes while dodging perilous rotating knives and uncovering hidden secrets. Coordinate with a friend to solve puzzles, pull levers to clear paths, and gather fish and bones for points in this adventurous, cooperative game.

How to Play

Getting started in Dog and Cat doesn't take long to learn. Join a lovable dog and cat duo on an enchanting quest! Collect scattered boxes while dodging perilous rotating knives and uncovering hidden secrets. Coordinate with a friend to solve puzzles, pull levers to clear paths, and gather fish and bones for points in this adventurous, cooperative game.
